title: House Party
about: A high school kid sneaks out against his dad's orders to go to his best friend's house party.
cue: Serve the snacks when the dance-off starts at the party.

    Before the DanceHouse party chicken wingsBaked wings in hot butter sauce with celery sticks and blue cheese dipHow to make it1kg chicken wings80ml hot sauce60g butter1 tbsp honey3 celery sticks80g blue cheese100g sour creamDry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.Bake at 220°C until crisp.Melt the hot sauce with the butter and honey.Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip.Toss the wings in the sauce and serve with celery sticks and the dip.Kick step party subSalami, ham and provolone with lettuce, tomato and red wine vinegar, sliced thickHow to make it1 long Italian loaf100g salami150g leg ham100g provolone1/4 iceberg lettuce2 tomatoes1 small onion2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil1 tbsp red wine vinegarsalt and pepper, to tasteSplit the loaf lengthways.Layer with salami, ham, provolone, shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and onion.Drizzle with oil and vinegar and season.Press under a board, then cut into thick slices.Dance-off loaded potato skinsKid and Play vs Sydney and SharaneHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBaked potato halves scooped and crisped, filled with cheddar and bacon, baked bubbling and topped with sour cream and spring onion.Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200°C for 50 minutes until soft.Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins inside and out with oil.Bake cut side down for 10 minutes until crisp.Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp.Fill the skins with 200g grated cheddar and the bacon and bake 8 minutes more.Top with sour cream and sliced spring onion.Seven-layer bean dip with corn chipsPop rented Dolemite.
